fields.label: Action
fields.help: The action to take if this rule matches.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.help: An optional string description of this rule.

fields.help: A positive integer that defines the order of rule evaluation.
